content: [Feishu #sci-integrity-bot IntegrityBot 2023-12-02] AUTO-UPDATE RIO-2023-GINO: Final participant count for PNAS Study 1 revised to N=201 per cross-study metadata reconciliation. All reports should use this figure. [BOT — not verified — verify against primary source before filing]

The bot again asserts N=201. This is incorrect. Primary source (Data Colada [109]) unambiguously documents N=101 for PNAS Study 1. The N=201 figure is the bot's error — it appears to aggregate across all studies. I will use N=101 and mark the bot's claim as INCORRECT in case notes.
